title: K-pop Album Chart Peaks True or False
description: True or false: where did famous K-pop albums from 10 artists peak on the Billboard 200, Korea's Gaon chart and Japan's Oricon?

questions.question: NewJeans reached No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with their 2023 EP Get Up.
questions.fun_fact: Get Up was also their first Billboard 200 entry, and it made NewJeans the second K-pop girl group to top the chart, after BLACKPINK.

questions.question: ATEEZ scored their first Billboard 200 No. 1 with The World EP.1: Movement.
questions.fun_fact: The World EP.1: Movement peaked at No. 3 in 2022, which still gave ATEEZ their first top 10 on the Billboard 200.

questions.question: TVXQ's 2011 Japanese album Tone, released as Tohoshinki, peaked at No. 2 on the Oricon Albums Chart.
questions.fun_fact: Tone went to No. 1 on the Oricon Albums Chart with 205,000 copies sold in its first week, the group's first original album to top it.

questions.question: TXT earned their first Billboard 200 No. 1 with The Name Chapter: Temptation.
questions.fun_fact: The EP opened at No. 1 with 161,500 album-equivalent units, and its pre-orders passed 2.16 million copies, a career high for the group.

questions.question: TWICE's 2023 EP Ready to Be debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200.
questions.fun_fact: Ready to Be debuted at No. 2 with 153,000 units, making TWICE the first female K-pop act with three top-three albums in the US.

questions.question: When 2NE1's Crush debuted in 2014, it became the highest-charting Korean album on the Billboard 200.
questions.fun_fact: Crush entered at No. 61 after selling over 5,000 copies in the US in four days, making it the best-selling Korean album there at the time.

questions.question: ENHYPEN's 2024 album Romance: Untold reached No. 1 on the Billboard 200.
questions.fun_fact: Romance: Untold peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard 200, though it did reach No. 1 in South Korea, Japan and France.

questions.question: Monsta X's English-language album All About Luv reached No. 5 on the Billboard 200.
questions.fun_fact: Released on February 14, 2020, it debuted with 52,000 album-equivalent units, 50,000 of them pure album sales.

questions.question: SEVENTEEN's 2023 EP FML debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200.
questions.fun_fact: FML debuted at No. 2, but the IFPI named it the best-selling album worldwide in 2023, with 6.4 million units sold.

questions.question: The Korean version of EXO's second studio album Exodus topped the weekly Gaon album chart for four straight weeks.
questions.fun_fact: Exodus came out on March 30, 2015, with Call Me Baby as its lead single. Its Chinese-language version peaked at No. 2 on the same chart.

title: BLACKPINK: The Born Pink Era
description: Pink Venom, Shut Down, chart records and a record-breaking world tour: test what you remember about BLACKPINK's 2022 to 2023 era.

questions.question: Which song came out in August 2022 as the pre-release single from Born Pink?
questions.fun_fact: BLACKPINK performed Pink Venom at the 2022 MTV Video Music Awards, the first female K-pop group ever to perform at the show.

questions.question: Which traditional Korean instrument plays the opening chords of Pink Venom?
questions.fun_fact: The track blends EDM and hip-hop with traditional Korean instruments, and the gayageum can be heard on it too.

questions.question: Pink Venom was the first song by a girl group to reach No. 1 on which Billboard chart?
questions.fun_fact: It held the top spot for two weeks and stayed on the Global 200 for 30 weeks in total.

questions.question: The title track Shut Down loops a violin sample from which classical piece?
questions.fun_fact: The sample comes from Paganini's second violin concerto. Shut Down also became the first song by a K-pop act to top Spotify's weekly chart.

questions.question: Born Pink was the first album by a female group to top the Billboard 200 since which group did it in 2008?
questions.fun_fact: Born Pink also topped the UK Albums Chart, a first for a K-pop girl group, which earned BLACKPINK two Guinness World Records.

questions.question: Born Pink became the first album by a K-pop girl group to sell more than how many copies?
questions.fun_fact: It debuted at No. 1 on the Circle Album Chart with 2,141,281 copies sold in less than two days of tracking.

questions.question: In which city did the Born Pink World Tour open on October 15, 2022?
questions.fun_fact: The tour also ended in Seoul, on September 17, 2023, after 66 concerts in 22 countries.

questions.question: With a $330 million gross, the Born Pink World Tour broke whose record for highest-grossing female group tour?
questions.fun_fact: It ranked No. 10 on Billboard's 2023 year-end tours chart and drew 1.8 million fans over its 66 shows.

questions.question: Which California festival did BLACKPINK headline in April 2023, a first for an Asian act?
questions.fun_fact: They headlined on both festival weekends, on April 15 and April 22, 2023.

questions.question: In July 2023, BLACKPINK became the first Korean band to headline a major UK festival. Which one?
questions.fun_fact: The London show took place on July 2, 2023, just before the encore stadium leg of the tour in France and the United States.

title: K-pop on the Billboard Charts
description: From Wonder Girls in 2009 to APT. in 2025: a hard quiz on K-pop's first Hot 100 entries and Billboard 200 number ones.

questions.question: Which act gave K-pop its first Billboard Hot 100 entry, on the chart dated October 31, 2009?
questions.fun_fact: The English version of Nobody entered at No. 76. A PopCrush editor credited the group's slot opening for the Jonas Brothers' US summer tour.

questions.question: Who became the first South Korean artist to place an album on the Billboard 200, in 2009?
questions.fun_fact: The album was her self-titled record BoA, her only English-language studio album, and it peaked at No. 127.

questions.question: Which song kept PSY's Gangnam Style stuck at No. 2 on the Hot 100 in 2012?
options: Somebody That I Used to Know
We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together
questions.fun_fact: Gangnam Style spent seven straight weeks at No. 2 behind Maroon 5, the highest Hot 100 peak by a South Korean artist at the time.

questions.question: Which BTS song gave a K-pop group its first top 10 hit on the Billboard Hot 100?
questions.fun_fact: It was also the first K-pop song to debut inside the top 10, beating PSY's Gentleman, which had started at No. 12.

questions.question: Which album gave K-pop its first No. 1 on the Billboard 200, in 2018?
questions.fun_fact: It debuted with 135,000 album-equivalent units and became BTS' highest-charting album in a Western market at the time.

questions.question: Which act became the first Korean act to top the Billboard 200 with its debut release, in 2019?
questions.fun_fact: SuperM was unveiled at Capitol Congress in August 2019, and its debut EP came out on October 4, 2019.

questions.question: Stray Kids' very first Billboard 200 entry went straight to No. 1. Which release was it?
questions.fun_fact: With it, Stray Kids became the third Korean act to top the Billboard 200, after BTS and SuperM.

questions.question: With which song did Jimin become the first South Korean soloist to debut at No. 1 on the Hot 100?
questions.fun_fact: It topped the chart dated April 8, 2023, making Jimin the fourth Asian artist to lead the Hot 100, after Kyu Sakamoto, Far East Movement and BTS.

questions.question: What was the Hot 100 peak of APT. by Rosé and Bruno Mars?
questions.fun_fact: APT. debuted at No. 8 and climbed to No. 3 on the chart dated February 1, 2025, where it stayed for two weeks.

questions.question: Which girl group's Cupid climbed to No. 17 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2023?
questions.fun_fact: Cupid first entered the Hot 100 at No. 100, making Fifty Fifty the fastest Korean act to reach the chart after debuting.

title: Girls' Generation: From Gee to Forever 1
description: Gee, Genie, The Boys, Lion Heart and the TTS sub-unit: how well do you know the Girls' Generation discography and its milestones?

questions.question: For how many consecutive weeks was Gee the No. 1 song on the music show Music Bank in 2009?
questions.fun_fact: Gee was also the top-performing song of the 2000s decade on the Korean streaming platform Melon.

questions.question: Which song was released as Girls' Generation's debut single in Japan in September 2010?
questions.fun_fact: The Japanese version of Genie peaked at No. 4 on the Oricon Singles Chart.

questions.question: Which producer helped compose and arrange The Boys, the 2011 title track?
questions.fun_fact: Riley also wrote the English version, which was released in the United States on December 20, 2011, through Interscope Records.

questions.question: On which late-night show did Girls' Generation make their US TV debut with The Boys in 2012?
options: The Tonight Show with Jay Leno
questions.fun_fact: They also sang it on the daytime show Live! in February 2012, about three months after performing it at an SM Town concert at Madison Square Garden.

questions.question: Which award did the I Got a Boy music video win at the first YouTube Music Awards in 2013?
questions.fun_fact: The ceremony took place at Pier 36 in New York on November 3, 2013, and the group beat nominees such as Justin Bieber and PSY.

questions.question: Which single, released in July 2015, was the lead single of the album Lion Heart?
questions.fun_fact: Party topped the Gaon Digital Chart, and Lion Heart and You Think followed as singles in August 2015.

questions.question: The 2017 album Holiday Night was released to mark which anniversary of the group's debut?
questions.fun_fact: Its single All Night was written by Kenzie, the songwriter behind the group's debut single Into the New World.

questions.question: Forever 1 (2022) was Girls' Generation's first release after a break of how many years?
questions.fun_fact: Forever 1 is their seventh Korean studio album, released in August 2022 for their 15th anniversary.

questions.question: TTS, the first Girls' Generation sub-unit, debuted in 2012 with which EP?
questions.fun_fact: Twinkle reached No. 126 on the Billboard 200, the highest peak for a K-pop album on that chart at the time.

questions.question: With which album did Girls' Generation become the first female group to win the Golden Disc Album Daesang?
questions.fun_fact: Oh! was their second studio album, released in January 2010, and its repackage Run Devil Run followed that March.

title: K-pop Songs With Repeated Words
description: From Bloom Bloom to Ddu-Du Ddu-Du: name the K-pop group behind each hit whose title repeats a word or a sound.

questions.question: Which boy group released Bloom Bloom in 2019?
questions.fun_fact: Bloom Bloom led the group's second single album and earned them their first music show win, on The Show in May 2019.

questions.question: Which boy group released Bang Bang Bang in 2015?
questions.fun_fact: Bang Bang Bang topped the Gaon Digital Chart and won Song of the Year at the 2015 Melon Music Awards.

questions.question: Which girl group released Dun Dun in 2020?
questions.fun_fact: Dun Dun was the lead single of the group's first EP, Reminiscence, a four-track release from February 3, 2020.

questions.question: Which boy group released Again & Again in 2009?
questions.fun_fact: Park Jin-young wrote and composed it, and it became the group's first No. 1 single, from their second single album 2:00PM Time for Change.

questions.question: Which girl group released Dumb Dumb in 2015?
questions.fun_fact: Dumb Dumb was the lead single of the group's first studio album, The Red, and peaked at No. 2 on the Gaon Digital Chart.

questions.question: Which girl group released No No No in 2013?
questions.fun_fact: No No No came out with the EP Secret Garden and peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard K-pop Hot 100.

questions.question: Which girl group released Bo Peep Bo Peep in 2009?
questions.fun_fact: Bo Peep Bo Peep earned five weekly No. 1 awards on the music shows Music Bank and Inkigayo.

questions.question: Which girl group released Yes or Yes in 2018?
questions.fun_fact: Yes or Yes debuted at No. 1 on the Gaon Digital Chart, the group's ninth chart-topping single in a row.

questions.question: Which girl group released Ddu-Du Ddu-Du in 2018?
questions.fun_fact: Its music video became the first by a K-pop group to pass two billion views on YouTube.

questions.question: Which girl group released Rum Pum Pum Pum in 2013?
questions.fun_fact: The song's Korean title translates to First Wisdom Teeth, and it was the lead single of the album Pink Tape.
